notes.subject: שאו … ובאו
notes.rationale: Imperatives 'lift up an offering and come' continue the summons to the nations.

notes.subject: siyaw ka mɔgɔjaw (v. 7)
notes.rationale: The addressees from v. 7 carry over; the imperatives here still speak to them.

notes.subject: saraka
notes.rationale: מנחה is specifically a tribute/grain-gift, not a blood sacrifice; 'saraka' is the fixed Tanakh-register term for offering.

notes.subject: aw tila a sanfe
notes.rationale: שאו מנחה literally 'lift an offering'; Bambara keeps the lifting picture rather than reducing it to 'bring'.

translation: Aw di Yawe ma a tɔgɔ ka bonya; aw ta saraka, aw tila a sanfe, aw na ⟨a⟩ ka dabada la.

tokens.gloss: aw ta … aw tila a sanfe
